title: Play-Nice Capability Declaration
description: Declares one capability: an intent-level concept a system owns, independent of any provider or tool that implements it. Providers implement or enrich capabilities; they never own the meaning.

capability_id.description: Stable machine identifier, snake_case (e.g. source_control, health).

title.description: Human concept name (e.g. Source Control, Health).

description.description: What the user can accomplish through this capability, in user language.

native_baseline.description: True when the system provides a useful local meaning without any third-party provider.

absence.description: What happens when every provider for this capability is removed. not_configured and degrades_gracefully keep the concept alive; unavailable_concept means the system cannot yet represent it, which must be explicit, never silent.

providers.description: Known provider types that implement or enrich this capability. Optional and open: new providers do not require a library change.
